notes.title: Update 4.5 - Phantom of Elites (New Enemies, LCK, Balance Update)
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, we have a new patch today with two main new features of [b]Elite Enemies[/b] and the [b]LCK Camera (LIV Creator Kit)[/b], big improvements to loading jitters, as well as some balance, tweaks, and optimizations.

[h2]Elite Enemies[/h2]
Obisidian soldiers can now spawn with one of a variety of special passive abilities (counter-shot, respawn on death, siphon health from allies, etc). The new ‘Captain’ type enemy will always have an ability, and other enemies may also rarely get these bonuses too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/750adccf6a481238e66debcacc101a3f6c534b8b.png[/img]


[h2]LCK Camera[/h2]
The new LCK camera can be found on the loadout table or toggled in the XR settings menu. This lets you record easily in-game footage from a variety of camera angles, including microphone input, and vertical orientation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/3f80427a9afec34db20f3494d8d85225668ad139.png[/img]

[h2]Loading Jitter Optimizations[/h2]
Lots of the jittery loading during killing enemies and looting at the start of a stage has been improved significantly. Enjoy!

And as always, reach out to us through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1579880/discussions/]Steam forums[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs]Discord[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/LightBrigadeGame/]Reddit[/url] with feedback or suggestions!

o7

notes.title: Update 4.0 - Phantom of Time (Major Content Update)
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, today we bring to you yet another major update to The Light Brigade -- [b]Phantom of Time[/b].

[b]Available NOW as a free MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE. Let's dive in![/b]

Step into the shadows with our latest update, introducing the [b][u]Saboteur[/u][/b], a revolver-wielding gunslinger with a powerful new ability: the [b]Timepiece[/b]. Cloak yourself and deploy a deadringer, allowing for swift escapes and tactical repositioning.

notes.title: Update 3.2 - Sun Hunter
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, we have another patch for our "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1579880/view/4173223363937100020]Shadow Hunter[/url]" major content update. Thank you to everyone for the feedback on general balance and issues, and digging up extra info to help us track down bugs.

This patch addresses many of the reported issues, and fixes a couple of long-standing bugs, in addition to several subtle core improvements that should improve the game overall.

[b]Notable Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Sun Run[/b]: Fixed the sun run showing 0% incorrectly and being mostly inaccessible.
[*] [b]Mountain Biome - Improved Cover[/b]: this zone often had no cover to take and made it unfairly difficult depending on random generation, it’s still a difficult zone sometimes but there should be more cover to help in the firefights now
[*] [b]Hunter Passive - Stacking Damage[/b]: the hunter had troubles scaling for higher difficulty enemies, and the passive (was critical hit %) is now a stacking damage for each arrow hit on the same enemy; will help a lot for ammo usage on harder difficulties and bosses
[*] [b]Enemy Aiming - Cover Peek Accuracy[/b]: when peeking from cover or very obstructed, enemies will have a slight aiming penalty now; so you are less likely to get insta-headshot while peeking
[*] [b]Enemies in Walls[/b]: fixed many issues with enemies spawning inside walls, mostly in ashen mountain and necropolis
[/list]

These changes are [b]**now live**[/b]. Full patch details are always here: 
[url=https://www.notion.so/funktroniclabs/Update-3-2-Sun-Hunter-74101d238b6b4b1f9146b212d65a6944?pvs=4]Full Patch Notes[/url]

Please continue to let us know any issues or general game feedback, we're always around (but most responsive on discord -- [url=discord.gg/funktroniclabs]discord.gg/funktroniclabs[/url]). Thanks!

notes.title: One-Year Anniversary Sale, Roadmap, and New Limited-Edition Art Prints!
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, today officially marks the 1-year anniversary since we've launched The Light Brigade on Feb 22, 2023. [b]Sheeeesh how time flies[/b]. We are celebrating with a 30% off sale!

I can still remember vividly the feeling on launch day. Our development team was gathered in a semi-circle around the monitor with the mouse cursor hovering anxiously above the "Release Now" button on Steamworks.  As 9am hit, we collectively took a deep breath and slammed the big green button. Thoughts were racing and heart-a-pounding with anxiety about how people would perceive our game. Will Funktronic succeed, or will we flop?

Thankfully, our game was well-received and we were able to grow an awesome community of folks. This allowed us to continue developing and improving upon the game post-launch. We see The Light Brigade as a canvas/foundation for us to build upon, and we are excited to give yall a sneak peak of the upcoming "roadmap" of what we are schemin' on next:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/c3bd10e5d5b32e01a657b90442fd0ca43ecd6df7.png[/img]

[h3][b]Roadmap[/b][/h3]
Since our initial launch, quite a lot has changed and it's been cool to grow our game with the feedback from our community. We've since deployed 10 patches, few major updates, new playable characters, new worlds, new items, etc -- and are excited to continue building upon the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/709a0c71b57d2fbcbf839100648c9f60c7b47de9.png[/img]

[h3][b]Limited Edition Art Prints[/b][/h3]
To celebrate our  1-year anniversary, we designed made some limited-edition high-quality art prints made by our talented artist Katrina -- available now on 60lb stock high-quality 18x24" poster. 

Inspired by old-school Japanese movie posters, these will be shipped in a protective tube. Available to US & Canada only (super sorry international folks). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/c778193b14a764385c020fcdf5798103062cc471.png[/img]
[h3]Buy poster here:[/h3]
> [url=https://shop.funktroniclabs.com/product/the-light-brigade-anniversary-print]Limited Edition Anniversary Art Print[/url]

Thanks again for such a fantastic year, really could not have achieved any of this without yall. Please stay tuned for more info regarding our upcoming "[b]Shadow Hunter[/b]" update. Consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs]Discord community[/url] as well to keep up to date on all the latest developments.

See you on the battlefield.

o7

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Memories of War (Major Content Update)
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, today we are stoked to bring you a huge content update to The Light Brigade -- [b]Memories of War[/b]. The update brings two new unlockable classes, new weapons, new tactical items, new hand-crafted areas, game modes and a ton of improvements and fixes. 

Let's dive in.

[b]"Memories of War" Trailer (2 min):[/b]
[previewyoutube=TgFhZBW9J0E;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Full Devlog Video (13 min):[/b]
[previewyoutube=uMsEEtU87f0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]New Unlockable Class: The Breacher[/b][/h3]
Get up close and person to deliver devastating damage with the pump-action [b]Winchester 1897[/b] (our most requested gun by far). This shotgun behaves like the real thing, so go full slam-firing mode for taking down the toughest Obsidian Soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/320a52116af2560d2a9ff78b55bbc6e0af7791c3.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Unlockable Class: The Engineer[/b][/h3]
The new tactical class, [b]Engineer[/b], comes with the steady and reliable [b]MP35[/b] submachine gun. Also, the engineer class can take command of  its pilotable [b]Skyhawk[/b] battle-drone. Deploy it to distract your enemies as you mow them down with your MP35. Use your pouch-mounted joystick to manually reposition your companion on the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/1b2b865c414230f77f0bd453d0ead5eb5b581e6f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New Tactical Items[/b][/h3]
We've added a ton of new tactical items that you can acquire to add more interesting variety to your runs. The new tactical loot box can be found in stages with a variety of new consumable and equip-able items, giving you much more tactical choices for dealing with tough situations. 
[list]
[*] [b]Boost Syringes[/b]: power up mid battle with a powerful injection. Ah, that's the stuff!
[*] [b]Canteen[/b]: holds multiple charges and heals on each drink, keep your health topped up
[*] [b]Defense Helmet[/b]: wear this to block a single gunshot of any kind, helmets save lives
[*] [b]Smokable Cigar[/b]: take a break and relax, or go kill with _style_
[*] [b]Flare Guns[/b]: summon allies forces to aid you during battle
[*] and much more, including rare variants with more special features! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/2906e05f5bbccef08a3e45af455a73da56e072eb.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Areas[/b][/h3]
The new [b]Lost Memories[/b] battlegrounds are hand-crafted stages that you will encounter during your runs. These stages are mixed in between the procedural stages to provide the player with even more variety.

[h3][b]New Firing Range[/b][/h3]
The new firing range is accessible from the Temple HQ, and is a great place to practice aiming and trying out new weapons. There are score and time target challenges, as well as free-shooting. Go here to get gud. 

[h3][b]New Custom Runs[/b][/h3]
The new Sacred Memories shrine has been added for late-game challenges. Custom your own personalized run by selecting from a series of custom runs presets each with their own run modifications and challenges. Difficult and challenging runs, good luck!

[h3][b]New Class Shrine[/b][/h3]
The new class selection shrine makes it easier to select and change classes, and looks much cleaner! We've added this to allow for more unlockable classes in the future.

[h3][b]New Legendary Tarot Card[/b][/h3]
Find the new ultra-rare legendary tarot card and enjoy a brand new power, or maybe too much power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/569ddd271aaf4f2b3b0cf2d454137361456f19d4.gif[/img]

Finally, a mountain of fixes, tweaks and optimizations across the board. You can check the full changelist below or dive right in. Good luck on the battlefield, and as always, reach out to us through the steam forums, discord (link) or reddit (link) with feedback or suggestions!

o7

PS. These build notes can also be found here: [url=https://www.notion.so/funktroniclabs/Update-2-0-Memories-Of-War-07a7b9fed1724d7b81e3fda8d3a65437]Update Notes[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Sights & Settings
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers, today we have a new update with some much-requested changes.

[h3]Critical Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a critical bug breaking save files when hitting end-run during daily run in some cases
[/list]

[h3]Notable Changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Added user-customizable iron sights and reticle colors - tweak these in the game settings for your personal preference
    [*]Improved red dot sight two have two depth markers, making accurate aiming possible again
    [*]Improved sniper inventory layouts - sniper ammo in the middle for easier left or right hand usage, or whether reloading with main or off-hand
    [*]Improved pistolier inventory layouts - added extra inventory pouch and extra wand slot, to balance out some of it's weakness compared to other classes
    [*]Reduce wobble on 1H pistol aiming - quality of life for pistol class
    [*]Reduced rushing behavior of enemies - particularly on harder difficulties the enemies tended to rush far too close, and had too much health to deal with, it should now be more of a close-range firefight than a face rush
[/list]

[previewyoutube=XTpW6cO_iDk;full][/previewyoutube]

Please let us know if you have any issues or feedback, and you can find us on discord, twitter, reddit or just post in the steam forums!

Full changelist and details can be found here: [url=https://funktroniclabs.notion.site/Update-1-1-Extra-Fix-Settings-07a7b9fed1724d7b81e3fda8d3a65437]https://funktroniclabs.notion.site/Update-1-1-Extra-Fix-Settings-07a7b9fed1724d7b81e3fda8d3a65437[/url]

notes.title: Update #1 - Community Feedback Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/660e98e98310f541127b9ab9af88ad22ea25d01e.jpg[/img]

Hello Soldiers, we've got an enormous amount of feedback since launch and have been hard at work getting everything improved. There are a new graphics settings to have more control for your setup, and a ton of VR settings to customize for your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158798/58e14e7e4f5066caf9f474666678f1aa899e41f6.gif[/img]

The other notable much requested features are redesigning the two-handed to only apply while aiming, trigger to grab the weapon bolt slide, trigger to store ammo, and increased difficulty levels (NG+++).

On top of that, we fixed a ton of bugs, balanced lots of weapons and enemies and upgrades, and improved a lot of things in general - thanks to everyone for the feedback, hopefully this improves the feel of the game for everyone.

[previewyoutube=2RTovaotpMY;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, reach out to us through the steam forums, discord ([url=https://discord.gg/funktroniclabs]link[/url]) or reddit ([url=www.reddit.com/r/LightBrigadeGame/]link[/url]) with feedback or suggestions!
